title: "modelling trade-off"

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(purrr)
library(broom)
library(MASS)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(car)
library(lmerTest)
```

LABORATORY-RAISED MOTHS
```{r}
results <- read.csv(here("data", "clean data", "results.csv"), colClasses = c(sex = "character"))

#make maternal ID a factor
results$grandmotherID <- as.factor(results$grandmotherID)

#make a treatment combination column, filter to only include ambient, warm and hot larval temp
results <- results %>%
  mutate(treatment_combination = paste(larval_treatment, pupal_treatment, sep = "_"))  %>%
  filter(larval_treatment %in% c("ambient", "warm", "hot")) %>%
  mutate(
    larval_treatment = factor(larval_treatment, levels = c("ambient", "warm","hot")),
    pupal_treatment = factor(pupal_treatment, levels = c("ambient", "cool","mean","warm","hot"))) %>%
  mutate(weight_mg = weight * 1000)  %>%
  mutate(weight_mg_centered = weight_mg - mean(weight_mg, na.rm = TRUE))

 
```

```{r}
#tests whether the relationship between egg size and clutch size depends on larval treatment
#tests whether the relationshp between egg size and clutch size is dependent on pupal treatment
#the interactions allows for different slopes for each larval treatment, and for different slopes depending on pupal treatment
#so i have both random intercepts and random slope for each treatment
trade_off_model <- lmer(egg_mean_1A ~ clutch_size * larval_treatment + clutch_size * pupal_treatment + weight_mg + (1|grandmotherID), data = results)
summary(trade_off_model)



# Type III anova because there is an interaction term in the model
Anova(trade_off_model, type = "III")


confint(trade_off_model)
icc(trade_off_model)

#maternal ID explains how much of the variance
4.77e-05/(4.77e-05 + 1.15e-04)
#maternal ID explains 29% of the variance in egg size

#checks for multicollinearity
vif(lm2)

```
```{r}
#make a word document of the model output
# Automatically extract random effects and observation counts from trade_off_model
vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(trade_off_model))
ngrps <- summary(trade_off_model)$ngrps

re_note <- sprintf(
  "Random effects: grandmotherID (Intercept) Variance = %.4f, SD = %.4f | Residual Variance = %.4f, SD = %.4f (Number of obs: %d, groups: grandmotherID = %d).",
  vc$vcov, vc$sdcor,
  vc$vcov, vc$sdcor,
  nobs(trade_off_model),
  ngrps["grandmotherID"]
)

modelsummary(
  list(" " = trade_off_model),
  effects = "fixed",
  estimate = "{estimate}{stars}",
  statistic = c(
    "Std. Error" = "{std.error}",
    "t value"    = "{statistic}",
    "Pr(>|t|)"   = "{p.value}"
  ),
  shape = term ~ model + statistic,
  fmt = 3,
  gof_map = NA,
  title = "Linear mixed model (REML) | Formula: egg_mean_1A ~ clutch_size * larval_treatment + clutch_size * pupal_treatment + weight_mg + (1 | grandmotherID)",
  notes = c(
    re_note,
    "Signif. codes: *** p < 0.001, ** p < 0.01, * p < 0.05, . p < 0.1"
  ),
  output = here("trade_off_model.docx")
)



```



WILD MOTHS 
```{r}
results <- read.csv(here("data", "clean data", "results.csv"), colClasses = c(sex = "character"))

results_wild <- results %>%
  filter(pupal_treatment == "wild")

#cant include pupal treament, larval treatment, weight (i didn't weigh them, oops), or maternalID - I don't have any of this information
lm1 <- lm(egg_mean_1A ~ clutch_size, data = results_wild)

summary(lm1)
#non significant effect of clutch size on egg size

```
```{r}
#make a word document of the model output
s <- summary(lm1)
fstat <- s$fstatistic
f_pval <- pf(fstat["value"], fstat["numdf"], fstat["dendf"], lower.tail = FALSE)

lm_note <- sprintf(
  "Residual standard error: %.3f on %d degrees of freedom | Multiple R-squared: %.4f, Adjusted R-squared: %.4f | F-statistic: %.2f on %d and %d DF, p-value: %.3g",
  s$sigma, s$df[2],
  s$r.squared, s$adj.r.squared,
  fstat["value"], fstat["numdf"], fstat["dendf"], f_pval
)

modelsummary(
  list(" " = lm1),
  estimate = "{estimate}{stars}",
  statistic = c(
    "Std. Error" = "{std.error}",
    "t value"    = "{statistic}",
    "Pr(>|t|)"   = "{p.value}"
  ),
  shape = term ~ model + statistic,
  fmt = 3,
  gof_map = NA,
  title = "Linear model (lm) | Formula: egg_mean_1A ~ clutch_size",
  notes = c(
    lm_note,
    "Signif. codes: *** p < 0.001, ** p < 0.01, * p < 0.05, . p < 0.1"
  ),
  output = here("wild_trade_off_model.docx")
)



```
